title: Morning, the sandpipers
logline: A morning two weeks before the last page: the pup charging a flock of sandpipers at the tide line, the flock lifting, the sun on the mud. The final page's bottom-right corner, rehearsed.

panels.composition: The tide line at sunrise: a scatter of sandpipers lifting all at once as a small three-legged dog charges into them, the mud gold, the channels blue, the birds' shadows on the wet sand. Nothing else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small three-legged dog charging into a lifting flock of sandpipers at a sunlit tide line on golden mudflats with the birds' shadows on the wet sand, no words
image.notes: The final page's lower-right, alone, two weeks early.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
